title: Radio-owned identity and optional portability
description: Record Mark's decision that normal messaging identity belongs to the radio, not the attached phone. Optional identity-key export/import may be supported by radios in future, but is explicitly deferred. Scope now is policy/LCI/agent guidance and deferred task tracking; no key movement, export endpoint, automatic migration or runtime changes.
acceptance_criteria: Radio-owned baseline is explicit and consistent with upstream Yggdrasil identity and node-owned UI state. Changing clients does not transfer/regenerate radio identity. Optional key portability is tracked as deferred and is not a baseline requirement.
